Vishwas K N Business Analyst

+91 8277024454 | vishwaskn8989@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/vishwas-k-n-hegde- 983bb312a/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience delivering KPI reporting, automation, and business insights across Telecom, Operations, Finance, Healthcare and EdTech. Strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel, and Python, with proven ability to gather requirements, define KPIs, build dashboards, validate data, and present insights to stakeholders. Focused on improving reporting accuracy, reducing manual effort, and enabling faster decision-making through data-driven recommendations. Experienced in operations reporting, KPI governance, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional teams.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Hard Skills: Requirements Gathering, Documentation, Business Analysis, Writing User Stories, Prototyping and Wireframing, Gap Analysis, Project Management, Agile Methodology, Planning and monitoring, UAT

Tools & Technologies: JIRA, Tableau, Confluence, Lucid Chart, SQL, Advanced Excel, MS PowerPoint, Power BI, Figma, Trello, Notion, Slack, Google Analytics, Balsamiq, Generative AI, ChatGPT, Gemini AI, Perplexity AI.

Product Strategy: Strategy Management, Stakeholder Management, Business Consulting, Business Functions Reporting, Market Analysis, Value Proposition Optimization, Strategic Presentations, Performance Tracking, Business Metrics Optimization

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (7+ YEARS)

Business Analyst | Dec 2019 - Present LSEG

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for projects and initiatives

Acted as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment and successful solution delivery.

Managed project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful project delivery. Provided mentorship and guidance to junior analysts and team members.

Conducted stakeholder interviews to gather requirements. Communicated with customers and suppliers to stay abreast of industry and business trends

Perform functional and regression testing for dashboards and reports developed in Tableau • Develop interactive dashboards, scorecards, and visual reports using Tableau & Validate data accuracy between source systems and dashboards

Monitor Tableau Server performance and usage metrics • Publish and maintain reports on Tableau Server / Tableau Cloud • Participated in user acceptance testing (UAT) and quality assurance processes to ensure the successful deployment of solutions.

Created documents for the projects namely, Scope document, Epic, User Stories, Wire Frames, Screen Mock- ups, Activity Diagram, Gap Analysis, Use Case Diagram and so forth.

Worked on fund accounting processes, including NAV calculation, portfolio reconciliation, and financial reporting to ensure accuracy, regulatory compliance, and timely delivery of investor reports

Conducted demos to stakeholders during the Sprint Review and educated clients on the project Trajectory. • Participated in scrum ceremonies including the Daily Standup, Sprint Planning Meeting, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospectives & Led the Scrum calls.

Developed comprehensive BRD and FSD that enhanced alignment among 10+ onshore clients, fostering clear communication and ensuring project success.

Developed detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD) capturing business objectives, stakeholder needs, project scope, and high-level requirements to ensure clear alignment across business teams

Created comprehensive Functional Requirement Documents (FRD/FSD) translating business requirements into detailed functional specifications, workflows, data mappings, and system behaviors for seamless development and implementation

• Created and managed end-to-end Power BI solutions, delivering 10+ impactful reports and 8+ interactive

dashboards that transformed complex data into actionable insights, empowering stakeholders to make informed decisions

Crafted and deployed DAX queries and optimized scripts for data analysis, producing insightful reports that inform key business decisions for teams of 50+ stakeholders while enhancing KPI visibility

Streamlined reporting by automating data pipelines using SQL, SAS, and Dataiku, ensuring seamless Tableau dashboard refresh cycles.

Junior Analyst | Jan 2019 – Oct 2019

Broadridge Financial Solutions Pvt Ltd

Analyzed financial and operational data to support reporting, reconciliation, and client deliverables within defined timelines.

Assisted senior analysts in preparing reports, validating datasets, and identifying discrepancies to ensure data accuracy and compliance.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to streamline workflows, maintain documentation, and improve process efficiency.

PROJECTS

Telecom Billing & Revenue Assurance System Worked on a billing and revenue assurance platform to ensure accurate charging, invoicing, and leakage detection across prepaid and postpaid services. Gathered and documented requirements, analyzed billing workflows, and collaborated with stakeholders to improve revenue tracking and minimize discrepancies.

Digital Loan Management System (Finance) Analyzed and documented requirements for a digital loan processing platform that streamlined loan applications, credit evaluation, and approval workflows. Collaborated with stakeholders to define user journeys, reduce processing time, and improve decision accuracy through data-driven insights.

Personalized Learning Analytics Platform (EdTech) Worked on a learning analytics system that tracked student performance and provided personalized course recommendations. Gathered requirements, created user stories, and supported the design of dashboards to help educators monitor progress and improve learning outcomes.

FHIR Project (Healthcare) Led the design and development of a FHIR-based mobile application that enables seamless access and search of patient data from EMR systems, while ensuring alignment with business needs through detailed requirement gathering and SRS documentation. Additionally, built an appointment scheduling application using Agile methodology, allowing users to book online and offline consultations. Provided training to developers and clients on FHIR concepts and application usage, ensuring smooth development, adoption, and usability.

Fraud Detection & Risk Monitoring System (Finance) Worked on a fraud detection platform to identify suspicious financial transactions using rule-based and data-driven approaches. Gathered and documented business requirements, defined risk indicators, and collaborated with stakeholders to design dashboards that improved fraud visibility and reduced financial losses.

EDUCATION

VISHVESVARAYA TECHNOLOGICAL UNIVERSITY Master of Business Administration | 2018

KARNATAKA UNIVERSITY

Bachelor of Commerce | 2016
